title: helm(private): stabilize values schema + init hooks for KMS / nodeSelector upgrades
author: Priya Patel
description: Stabilize the Helm chart values schema and init hook templates used for Redwood Private deployments. Motivation: customers running on-prem / VPC reported upgrade failures when KMS and nodeSelector/tolerations were present. The chart previously allowed multiple shapes for encryption and scheduling fields which caused Helm to treat upgrades as incompatible and triggered hook re-creation in some clusters. This PR: 1) Unifies values.schema.json to a single canonical shape for encryption, kms, nodeSelector, and tolerations; 2) Adds defensive templating in templates/init-jobs.yaml to tolerate missing fields during upgrades; 3) Adds a lightweight migration hook (post-upgrade) that converts legacy encryption config to the new schema when detected; 4) Adds unit tests for Helm template rendering and a chart README note about the schema v3 migration path. Checklist: - [x] Update values.schema.json (v3) with explicit optional properties and examples - [x] Make init hook templates idempotent (skip when resources already exist) - [x] Add migration hook and guard it behind .Release.IsInstall|IsUpgrade checks - [x] Add chart unit tests (helm-unittest) and CI job - [x] Update docs/upgrade.md with rollback guidance Breaking changes: none for correctly-shaped values, but older ad-hoc encryption shapes may be migrated automatically (see release notes).

merge_summary: Merged via squash on main by Priya Patel - includes values.schema.json v3 and migration hook. No rollback required post-merge. Release notes added to charts/private/README.md and release changelog.
release_notes:
- Stabilize values schema for private chart (v3).
- Init hooks are now idempotent and tolerate missing encryption/nodeSelector fields.
- Migration hook added to automatically translate legacy encryption fields to v3.
- CI tests added for encryption/nodeselector rendering.
Notes: Users with bespoke encryption shapes should read charts/private/README.md before upgrading; automatic migration will attempt safe translation but backups are recommended.
